purpose: Exploratory design diagnosis after viewing earlier labels; not held-out validation, human review, accuracy estimation, or population proportions
sampling: 20 randomly selected unique texts per each of 6 v3-no-positive strata; 10 positive controls; all 1 readable-positive-v3/insufficient-v2 conflict
independent_validation_exclude: All 131 unique texts and exact duplicates must be excluded from new design-independent checks
important_interpretation: omitted_family counts are identifiable expression families omitted by v3, not false-negative accuracy
narrow_boundary means a broader parent or other axis has a visible cue but the existing finer v3 child need not be positive
axis_recoverable_fragment means useful content/form can be known while event/meaning remains unknown
possible_coding_issue means a candidate error requiring independent adjudication, not validated error
semantic_insufficiency cannot be solved by labeling all records other
